related.title: Bluetooth Classic AFH：壞頻道排除與碰撞比例
related.titleEn: Bluetooth Classic AFH: bad-channel exclusion and collision fraction
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 80 ms 與 45 ms，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 80 ms and 45 ms, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋25.3164556962 % bad-channel occupancy與7.8125 % bad-channel occupancy，建立afh_channels.csv、排除前後集合、干擾年齡，並完成以下驗收：教學占用率10%上限由第二組通過；另保留頻道數與協定限制，不對真實設備設定頻譜封鎖。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 25.3164556962 % bad-channel occupancy and 7.8125 % bad-channel occupancy; create afh_channels.csv, pre/post exclusion sets and interference age; apply this acceptance decision: Only the second passes a10% teaching occupancy cap; retain channel-count/protocol constraints without reconfiguring real spectrum use.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 漫遊中斷由掃描、驗證與重新關聯等串接步驟構成；快切換只能縮短其中部分。 展開基準式 30+40+10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：以事件名稱與單調時間戳量測每段；最後舊AP封包到新AP首包需涵蓋全部空隙。 將兩條推導一起存入 roam_events.csv、分段中斷表、裝置能力證據。
從原理 自適應跳頻避免已知干擾頻道；以均勻獨立跳頻模型估壞頻道比例，不能把它當實際封包錯誤率。 展開基準式 20/79*100；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：建立79列channel_id與bad/excluded欄，逐列計數；排除頻道不可仍出現在跳頻集合。 將兩條推導一起存入 afh_channels.csv、排除前後集合、干擾年齡。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Roaming interruption includes scanning, authentication and reassociation; fast transition only shortens some components., expand baseline expression 30+40+10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Measure named phases with monotonic timestamps; last-old-AP to first-new-AP timing must include all gaps. Save both derivations with roam_events.csv, phase-delay table and client-capability evidence.

Starting from Adaptive hopping avoids known interfered channels; a uniform independent-hop model estimates bad-channel occupancy, not actual packet error rate., expand baseline expression 20/79*100; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Build79 rows with channel_id and bad/excluded flags, enumerate counts, and ensure excluded channels leave the hop set. Save both derivations with afh_channels.csv, pre/post exclusion sets and interference age.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IEEE 802.15.4z UWB：雙向測距與轉向延遲
related.titleEn: IEEE802.15.4z UWB: two-way ranging and turnaround delay
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 80 ms 與 45 ms，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 80 ms and 45 ms, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋3 m與2.7 m，建立uwb_timestamps.csv、轉向校正表、首徑證據，並完成以下驗收：0.1 m教學誤差預算無法容忍2 ns轉向誤記；需要校準，不由RSSI推定精確距離。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 3 m and 2.7 m; create uwb_timestamps.csv, turnaround corrections and first-path evidence; apply this acceptance decision: A0.1 m error budget cannot tolerate the2 ns turnaround error; calibrate instead of inferring precise range from RSSI.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 漫遊中斷由掃描、驗證與重新關聯等串接步驟構成；快切換只能縮短其中部分。 展開基準式 30+40+10；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：以事件名稱與單調時間戳量測每段；最後舊AP封包到新AP首包需涵蓋全部空隙。 將兩條推導一起存入 roam_events.csv、分段中斷表、裝置能力證據。

從原理 理想單側雙向測距ToF=(roundtrip-turnaround)/2，距離=c*ToF；兩時鐘尺度不一致會留下偏差。 展開基準式 (120-100)*0.000000001/2*300000000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：先扣轉向再除二，反推3 m應需20 ns往返傳播；額外2 ns紀錄誤差造成0.3 m偏移。 將兩條推導一起存入 uwb_timestamps.csv、轉向校正表、首徑證據。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Roaming interruption includes scanning, authentication and reassociation; fast transition only shortens some components., expand baseline expression 30+40+10; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Measure named phases with monotonic timestamps; last-old-AP to first-new-AP timing must include all gaps. Save both derivations with roam_events.csv, phase-delay table and client-capability evidence.

Starting from Ideal single-sided TWR hasToF=(roundtrip-turnaround)/2 and distance=c*ToF; mismatched clock scales leave bias., expand baseline expression (120-100)*0.000000001/2*300000000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Subtract turnaround before halving;3 m implies20 ns round-trip propagation and2 ns record error causes0.3 m bias. Save both derivations with uwb_timestamps.csv, turnaround corrections and first-path evidence.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
